# Lumen 1.3.2

Mostly a bug-squashing release. I had a list of small but annoying issues piling up from my own testing and a few reports, so this round is about making the things that already work not bite you in weird edge cases. Also tightened a couple of security corners while I was in there.

---

### Bug Fixes & Improvements
- Active Account Protection During Uploads: Removing the account that's currently uploading used to just delete it mid-run. Now the "Upload in Progress" dialog kicks in with a toast, and you can only remove it once the queue is done or cancelled. Your session stays put.
- No More Fake "All Backed Up!" Celebrations: The completion card now actually checks the queue — if anything ended up FAILED or STOPPED, you get the failed items list instead of confetti. Clean runs still celebrate like before.
- Add Account Dialog Keeps Your Work: Submitting an invalid token used to slam the dialog shut and eat what you pasted. Now the dialog stays mounted while the request is in flight and only closes on success, so a failed attempt keeps your token in the field. "Try Again" on onboarding also works again (it was silently doing nothing — my bad).
- Smoother Large Batches: The queue UI was rebuilding and re-emitting on every 32 KB progress chunk, which turned 1,000+ file backups into a slideshow. Progress updates are now throttled to roughly 4×/second per file; status transitions still emit instantly.
- Unsupported Files Filtered on the Fast Path: The MediaStore scan didn't apply the extension filter, so things like `.txt` and `.pdf` in DCIM/Pictures got enqueued and then failed one by one. It now matches the recursive scan's extension list.
- Folder Permission Gating: Adding a folder before All-Files access was actually granted could leave it "enabled" but dead. New folders save as disabled and only flip on once the permission is verified on return, with a toast if you decline.
- Delete-After-Backup Safety Check: Toggling "Delete device copy after backup" then declining the All-Files permission prompt no longer leaves the flag armed. It only sticks after `isExternalStorageManager()` comes back true; otherwise it stays off with a toast.
- Captive Portal Wi-Fi Detection: The "Wi-Fi only" check treated any Wi-Fi connection as good, including portals and routers with no real internet — uploads would just stall and fail. It now requires `NET_CAPABILITY_INTERNET` + `NET_CAPABILITY_VALIDATED`, so those situations show the "Waiting for Wi-Fi" notice instead.
- Account Block Scoping Audit: Audited the shared account-block flow after it looked like a cross-account overwrite. It's fine — blocks are persisted per account and the in-memory flow is only trusted for the matching email, so account A's block banner never shows while you're viewing B, and blocks survive restarts. No change needed, just verified.

---

### Security Hardening
- Update Installer Verification Hardening: The pre-install check (package name + signing certificate SHA-256 against the installed app) now retries archive parsing with extra metadata flags for OEM builds where `getPackageArchiveInfo` returns null on perfectly valid APKs, and if parsing still fails it only defers to the system installer when the APK was staged by Lumen's own updater in its private cache directory — anything else fails closed with a "could not verify update package" message instead of blindly handing the file to the installer.
- Crypto Library Bump: Updated `androidx.security:security-crypto` from `1.1.0-alpha06` (a 2023 alpha) to the `1.1.0` stable release for the token storage layer. Same APIs, supported line.
